description: This file defines the 'GalleryScreen' widget for a Flutter app, implementing a media gallery with filtering options for photos and videos. It includes UI components such as grid views, filter pills, and media cards, and interacts with data and theme services.

classes.name: GalleryScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a media gallery with filtering options.

classes.name: _GalleryScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and behavior of the GalleryScreen, including filtering logic and layout.

classes.name: _MediaCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing individual media items (photos/videos) within the gallery.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the GalleryScreen widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the GalleryScreen and _MediaCard widgets, including layout and UI components.
